_readme: LIVE onboarding config for SpeedShield v23/b52+ (schema 2; builds 50-51 accept only schema 1 and fall back to their bundled default, which is the same content they shipped with). Editing this file changes the fresh-install onboarding cards (count, order, template, copy, colors, images), the paywall copy, the locked-map banner, the dismiss button, and the trial reminder on users' next launch — no app release. The app validates before rendering and falls back to its bundled default on any parse error. TEMPLATES: hero_moment (app-icon tile, headline, sub, road illustration with the 'quote' bubble), features (3 wired panels from 'bullets'; optional 'note' + 'note_icon' line above the button), timeline (nodes + panels from 'bullets'; 'footnote' under the button; requires_trial=true hides the card when the store offers this user no free trial), full_image (image_url rendered whole; dormant escape hatch). ICONS: bluetooth, map, update, volume, unlock, lock, bell, star, shield, car, camera, navigation, city, calendar, clock, check_circle, check. TOKENS in any copy: {trial_days} {price} {period} {annual_price} {monthly_price} {store} {cancel_path} — filled from STORE data on the device (never from this file; App Store rule 3.1.2 and the Play Subscriptions policy both require the shown price to be the store's). Unknown tokens render literally. PAYWALL: 'hero' = app_icon | https URL | none; 'headline_accent' = the substring of 'headline' drawn in the accent color; 'terms_trial'/'terms_no_trial' = the policy line under the CTA (must keep stating trial length, price after, and how to cancel); 'dismiss_platforms' = where the launch-gate 'Not now' shows (['android'] by default — Google Play requires a dismiss that leaves the purchase flow; iOS has no such rule); 'reshow_days' = days after a dismiss before the funnel shows itself again (0 = never; the locked-map banner and Settings remain the way back). THEME: bg/bg_top/bg_bottom (page gradient), panel, panel_selected, panel_border, accent, button, text, dim, good/good_bg/good_border, dot_inactive, danger (the camera pin). Per-card 'header' = app_icon | https URL | absent; per-card 'bg' = 6-digit hex over the theme. If you change reminder.day_offset, update the 'Day 5' timeline text to match. NEVER put prices in a graphic.

cards.headline:
Know before

bullets.body: 23 Phoenix-area cameras, updated as locations change.

Everything unlocked.
Free for {trial_days} days.

Start driving
smarter—free for {trial_days} days

reminder._note: day_offset drives the ACTUAL notification (fires day_offset days after trial start, same time of day the trial began; clamped 1-6). If you change it, also update the 'Day N' timeline card text above so the promise matches the delivery.
reminder.title: Your free week ends soon
reminder.body: SpeedShield keeps watching for cameras — you don't need to do anything. Cancel anytime in your app store settings.
